video_title: They said Wembanyama is OVERRATED 🤯 and we CRASHED OUT

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama needs to win to be compared to all-time greats
quotes.excerpt: There's nobody in the league that can touch Wemby individually because of what he does on both ends.
quotes.quote: The one thing I'm saying to you, Theo, is like, it has to, it has to be some winning into it as well. You have to, you have to put winning into it. Individually, we know there, be honest with you, there's nobody in the league that can touch Wemby individually because of what he does on both ends. You, you scared of him defensively, and you're scared of him offensively because there's nothing nobody can do with him. But he still has to win. Like, to put him up there with MJ and Magic and all these guys like y'all been saying.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama is the best player based on the eye test
quotes.excerpt: Wemby is the best player in the NBA to me.
quotes.quote: Wemby is the best player in the NBA to me. Ray's point, his point is he needs to win for me to give him that crown. With my eyes, regardless if Wemby won it this year, I still think, all right, everyone is going to plan now that that motherfucker is the best player in the league and we have to beat him.

quotes.speaker: Hong
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama needs consistency to be crowned the best
quotes.excerpt: Being consistent is part of your greatness. And Wemby doesn't have that yet.
quotes.quote: But here's the thing, right, Theo, to Ray's point, right, I think we've said it before. Being consistent is part of your greatness. And Wemby doesn't have that yet, and he's been inconsistent. And that doesn't mean that he's young, I get it. He's going to have to figure it out. But how can you crown him the best player in the world if he doesn't have that consistency because he is so up and down in his play?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs supporting cast must step up for wins
quotes.excerpt: Be physical with Wemby and see if these guys can make shots.
quotes.quote: McConnell and Caruso, bro, killed last night. That's what I'm saying. So, Marcus is not going to let Wemby just beat them. If they win, then Keldon and Vassell and those guys are going to have to win. Period. And I think they did a great job last night. When Wemby got the ball, Wemby saw three or four bodies, and he had Hartenstein on him who's being physical, and then Chet was meeting him at the rim. So he did the right thing last night, he made the pass. He passed the ball to those guys, they didn't make shots. Simple as that. If they made shots, might have been a different game. But they didn't. So with that being said, that's the game plan from here on. Be physical with Wemby and see if these guys can make shots. If they make shots, they might win this series, they might win the next two. Or if they don't make shots, they're in trouble.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating the difference between embellishing and flopping
quotes.excerpt: He ran and he stopped and he ran into his body, then he falls. That's embellishing a call.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong
text_blocks.text: Because Theo sat here and argued that selling a call is different. You guys had a huge argument that selling a flop. He bumped into him. He embellished.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That's selling, no, he's not going to the basketball. He doesn't have the ball. He ran and he stopped and he ran into his body, then he falls. That's embellishing a call.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Defining 'embellish' and its use in basketball discussions
quotes.excerpt: Embellish is like if you're going to the basket and someone reaches, you reach the ball out, you're embellishing that you got hit.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Why the fuck are we using embellishing? What the fuck is an embellish?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Embellish is like if you're going to the basket and someone reaches, you reach the ball out, you're embellishing that you got hit.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong
text_blocks.text: Embellish just means like to make something more attractive.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Why are you always trying to sound like smart and shit? What the fuck is embellishing, Chet? When we talk about basketball, we like, we don't use that word.

quotes.speaker: Keldon Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs struggle with physicality and missed open shots
quotes.excerpt: I think we just missed a lot of open shots tonight.
quotes.quote: Trying to play through it, you know, it's tough. I just think with the way they guard, how physical they are, we don't get that same luxury to be able to play as physical on the other end at times, but offensively, I think we do a good job of screening and playing through it. So I think we create a lot of advantages, but I think we just missed a lot of open shots tonight.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Old NBA games were more physical with fewer fouls called
quotes.excerpt: This is how they used to play back in the day. Look at this. No call, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, because this nigga knew how to manipulate the whole game, bro. Like, look at this. This is how they used to play back in the day. Look at this. Look at that. They would have called all this. They would have called all this. They would have called flagrant or whatever. Look at that. No call, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Look at this. That right there, you know, that would have been a foul. Look at this. They would have called all this now. Now they would have been a, man, they would have called flagrant or whatever. Look at that. You think these kids could have played with that, CV? Come on, man.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Players skip media to avoid saying dumb things when upset
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes you might want to save yourself from saying some dumb shit.
quotes.quote: Listen, bro, we talking about a human. Some days, you know, sometimes you might want to save yourself from saying some dumb shit. Like, I'm so mad that I can't talk. I'm that upset. I'm going to bash the referees, they're going to fine me 50k. I'm going to bash the media because somebody's going to ask me a dumbass question. So I'm that upset. So I'm going to leave. I don't want to do media today. Tell them I talk to them after shootaround.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Rather lose money than say something stupid after a loss
quotes.excerpt: I might as well lose money and not say nothing.
quotes.quote: He said he's going to lose money either way. So I might as well lose money and not say nothing. Because I'm going to go out there and spazz the fuck out on somebody. I mean, at the end of the day, you got to do your job. It's a part of the job. But there, like you said, there's sometimes you're hot and you don't want to address it, right? And that was one of those moments. I would say the same thing about Bron. If Bron didn't want to speak, guess what? The nigga didn't want to speak. Point blank, period.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: It's stupid to penalize Wembanyama for his height
quotes.excerpt: Why the fuck would Wemby, at his fucking height, play with the back to the basket?
quotes.quote: Wemby is overrated? He's not overrated. He refuses to play, he refuses to put his back to the basket. Why the fuck would Wemby, at his fucking height, and his frail, play with the back to the basket? What advantage is he going to have with that? So let me ask you something. We're going to penalize this man because he's 7'6"? That's fucking stupid. That makes no sense. Oh, he's 7'6", that's the only reason he's good. Oh, LeBron James is 6'9", 280, that's the only reason he's good. Kobe Bryant worked on his footwork and he worked on his game all the time, that's the only reason he's good. Michael Jordan has God-given ability, that's why he's good. Shaquille O'Neal is the biggest human and the strongest human ever to fucking live, that's the reason he's good. Shut the hell up. That's stupid.

quotes.speaker: Hong
quotes.summary_phrase: Fans prefer skill-based players because they are more relatable
quotes.excerpt: People will like a type of player like that more because they're like, oh shit, you have to go potentially put in work for that.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong
text_blocks.text: So Wemby being doing the step-back three, tween-twing. I'm not talking about Wemby. We're talking about the more physical imposing players. Like who? Like a Dwight Howard, a Shaq. That's what I'm talking about. You can't really relate to that, as Theo said. But I said because a guy like Kyrie Irving is more skill-based, and you could go work on that. Don't say you'll ever become Kyrie Irving. People will like a type of player like that more because they're like, oh shit, you have to go potentially put in work for that. Where people will argue that your physical gifts. I'm not saying that's true. I'm just saying. No, I literally just said, you said because it's more relatable, you can go out in the park, right? And be like, oh, I can work on this like Steph can. I can't go do it. I get that part.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What the fuck are you talking about, Hong? So Bron doesn't have skill because he's 6'8", 280? No, no, no. I told you what you should have fucking said. Please. Yeah, you got to break this down. Because you're diminishing, like.
